_comment: IndexNow key for kshana.dev (https://www.indexnow.org/documentation). Not a secret by design: build.py publishes it as /<key>.txt, the file a search engine fetches to confirm the site owns the key. After a deploy, ping once with the command in PORT-RUNBOOK.md (section: After a deploy). Changing the key means the next ping re-verifies; there is no other effect.
